compatibility.sourceRole: Protected U19 checkpoint; representative compatibility evidence only, not migration authority
compatibility.unknownRootFieldsPolicy: Preserve exact original bytes and all unknown fields; derive and validate the later projection without flattening or dropping them.

limitations: Design model only; no live YouTrack/project/ROM/installer checks or writes.
Schema evaluator covers this bundle’s keywords only; an independent standard metaschema/validator check remains a later implementation gate.
No production parser, authorization, durable discovery, conditional-write or cross-issue atomicity is established.
Examples use only fictional identities, source paths, assets and ROM evidence. Production must reject illustrative evidence.
No migration, complete legacy projection or real ROM extraction has been implemented.
